surfaces.fixture: branch-complete.json rendered through the real components, carrying per-tenant brand tokens and the real next/font faces. Content-bearing and CMS-independent.
surfaces.live: local next dev via SIRA_VISUAL_DIFF_LOCAL_ORIGIN. Covers the shell only; its content sections are empty because the CMS is unauthored.

method.tenantInvariance: All four tenants render through ONE shared BranchHomepage component set, so a design finding is tenant-invariant by construction. Per-tenant variation is brand tokens, asserted pairwise-distinct in tests/harness and verified in each fixture render. Each cell is therefore stated for every tenant rather than re-derived four times.
method.referenceAuthority: .dc.html is the desktop comparison reference. docs/SIRA-EDITORIAL-ARCHITECTURE-SPEC.md section 19 governs: a composition change is not a bug merely because it differs from .dc. The specification, accessibility, responsive behaviour and the shared headless architecture override the canvas.

responsiveInterpretation.detail: The reference canvases are fixed-width and overflow their own viewport at 390px - the header CTA runs off-screen - so they are not the mobile or tablet authority. The implementation reflows instead. No horizontal overflow at 1440, 768 or 390: verify:layout 75/75 and verify:fixtures 114/114 both assert it.

matrix.detail: The fixture composer deliberately excludes the shell, so the header was not assessed on the comparable surface in this increment. Two live-surface observations are carried forward: the CTA label and wordmark come from the CMS (CMS_CONTENT_DIFFERENCE), and the CTA is a pill where the reference draws a square (OWNER_DESIGN_CHOICE, no systemic evidence either way, not changed here).

Structure matches the reference: leading rule, uppercase tracked eyebrow, two-line display heading whose second clause is italic in the brand accent, then description. The hero was the only section already drawing the rule; it now uses the shared SectionEyebrow so there is one definition.

Full-bleed accent band, display-serif numeral over an uppercase tracked label, vertical dividers between columns - as the reference. Column distribution is NOT_ASSESSABLE: the fixture carries two statistics and the reference four.
Eyebrow lacked the leading rule the reference applies to every section. Fixed via SectionEyebrow.

Numbering, rules and spacing match. Item titles render in the display serif where the reference uses bold sans; six of seven card components already use font-display, so this is a consistent system choice and the specification governs over .dc.html. Not changed.

Eyebrow lacked the rule and used text-brand-ink-faint (grey) where the reference and our own branch-overview use the accent. Fixed. Card title serif is DNA_PRESERVED_COMPOSITION_EVOLVED. Status badge presentation is NOT_ASSESSABLE: the fixture project carries no status.
Same eyebrow rule and grey-accent defects as projects. Fixed.

Eyebrow rule fixed (bright tone on the deep section). The SEND MESSAGE control is muted with the note 'Online message submission isn't available yet' where the reference shows a solid accent button: OWNER_DESIGN_CHOICE, kept as-is, because styling a non-functional control as an active primary CTA is a misleading affordance and accessibility governs over .dc.html.

Excluded from the fixture composer. Live-surface observations carried forward: literal 'sss' body text and the copyright entity are CMS_CONTENT_DIFFERENCE; the footer navigation row absent from the reference is OWNER_DESIGN_CHOICE. Not changed here.
